subject: When do Todo and Yuji first fight each other?

beats.title: Personality
beats.text: By the time Todo found him, Yuji's body and mind were both battered and beaten by Mahito. Upon rescuing Yuji, Todo confidently stated that they were the exception to the rule that the prosperous must decline. Despite Yuji's condition, Todo encouraged him to get back up because their fight had just begun.(Chapter 126, Episode 44)

beats.title: Plot Details
beats.text: Todo tells Yuji that he doesn't need to answer right now. However, until he does, the first-year can never stop fighting. Todo believes that is the only punishment jujutsu sorcerers must endure. He expresses this to Yuji and runs ahead to fight Mahito.

beats.title: Event / Climactic Stages / 11:14 P.M. - 11:36 P.M. Shibuya Station
beats.breadcrumb: Event / Climactic Stages / 11:14 P.M. - 11:36 P.M. Shibuya Station
beats.text: Satisfied with crushing Yuji's psyche and his body, Mahito goes in for the kill. An instant before he beheads his longtime adversary, a clapping sound echoes through the corridor. Mahito suddenly switches places with none other than Yuji's "official best friend" Aoi Todo. He's accompanied by Kyoto first-year Arata Nitta, who performs first aid on Nobara. Arata expresses that he doesn't believe she will survive but Todo ignores him and tells Arata to treat Yuji using his innate technique. Todo asks Yuji to stand and fight because the climactic final battle has just begun.(Chapter 126, Episode 44)

beats.title: Personality
beats.text: While mentoring Yuji during the Goodwill Event, Todo showed a much more intelligent and even philosophical side of himself. Todo found much enjoyment in fighting with Yuji and took pride in helping foster his potential. He showed Yuji how to properly channel his cursed energy by effectively explaining how it's supposed to flow. Todo understands most people think of their body in disproportionate parts, but that every individual actually exists in the world with their entire mind, body, and soul, something most people take for granted.(Chapter 37, Episode 16) This philosophy is what trigged Yuji to step up his level of jujutsu considerably, eventually even learning to unleash Black Flash.(Chapter 48, Episode 19)

beats.title: Event / Climactic Stages / 11:14 P.M. - 11:36 P.M. Shibuya Station
beats.breadcrumb: Event / Climactic Stages / 11:14 P.M. - 11:36 P.M. Shibuya Station
beats.text: Yuji and Todo fight another special grade together, continuing the battle against Mahito inside Shibuya Station. Mahito tries to formulate a strategy around calculating the strength of each combatant's soul; Todo is operating at full strength while Mahito and Yuji have less than half their maximum health.

beats.title: Usage / Aoi Todo
beats.text: During his and Yuji's battle with Mahito, Todo succeeded in unleashing Black Flash by kicking Mahito, not wanting to be left behind by Yuji's growth. However, this was unable to do any lasting damage to the cursed spirit due to his soul being unaffected by the attack.(Chapter 128, Episode 44)

beats.title: Personality
beats.text: Todo is supremely confident in himself and revels in heated combat even when the situation is extremely dangerous. He made light of his own achievements during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons, revealing to Megumi he only needed his cursed technique to defeat a special grade.(Chapter 17, Episode 8) Despite undoubtedly possessing more cursed energy than Todo, Hanami was wary of him before they ever exchanged blows just based on his intense presence and supreme confidence.(Chapter 48, Episode 19) Todo's peers recognize that he's the most powerful out of all of them but they don't get along at all and everyone finds him irritating. In the baseball game, it was made abundantly clear that Todo is seriously hated by all the other students. Maki hit him in the face with the baseball and everyone other than Yuji praised her for the "nice pitch".(Chapter 54, Episode 21)

beats.title: Event / Climactic Stages / 11:14 P.M. - 11:36 P.M. Shibuya Station
beats.breadcrumb: Event / Climactic Stages / 11:14 P.M. - 11:36 P.M. Shibuya Station
beats.text: Back in the fight, Yuji apologizes to Nanami for almost giving up and promises to take on his share of suffering as well. Yuji lands a powerful Black Flash that completely destroys Mahito's block. After reeling back from getting his arm destroyed, Mahito smiles in reaction to Yuji coming back from the dead. Todo welcomes his best friend back to the battle as Yuji stands next to him ready to go.(Chapter 127, Episode 44)
